entries.en: How did Weyland help you, exactly?
He made sure we'll find Grayson at home when we stop by.
entries.ro: S-a asigurat că-l găsim pe Grayson acasă când trecem pe la el.

entries.en: So we know where to look for him.
Sure you're up for this?
entries.en_m: Ya sure you're up for this?

entries.en: Good luck!
'Eey, V.
Weyland? Of THE Weylands?
Wanna join us?
Weyland? Of THE Weylands?
Yes, girl. I take it ya heard of old Andrew Boa Boa?
entries.en_m: Yeah, man. I take it ya heard of old Andrew Boa Boa?
entries.ro: Da, fată. Cred că ai auzit de bătrânul Andrew Boa Boa, nu?
entries.ro_m: Da, băiete. Cred că ai auzit de bătrânul Andrew Boa Boa, nu?

entries.en: Like everybody in this town.
entries.ro: Ca toată lumea din orașul ăsta.

entries.en: Gonna be joinin' us?
Nah, I already did me part.
Don't tell me you don't wanna see Smasher dead.
entries.ro: Nu-mi spune că nu vrei să-l vezi pe Smasher mort.

entries.en: Look who we have here.
V, Crispin Weyland. He's helping us.
I hear you're hunting Smasher.
Ready? We'll talk on the way.
Let's roll.
Got something to tend to first.
entries.ro: Am ceva de rezolvat mai întâi.

entries.en: Got something I gotta do first.
entries.en_m: I got somethin' I gotta do first.
entries.ro: Am ceva de făcut mai întâi.

entries.en: Let's go.
Jump in.
Comin' back later?
We goin'?
Gotcha a little somethin'.
Try it on.
Finally lookin' half decent.
entries.ro: În sfârșit arăți cât de cât decent.

entries.en: Thanks.
Thanks.
This Johnny's?
This Johnny's jacket?
With me wearin' it, sure you won't confuse us?
entries.en_m: With me wearin' it, you sure you won't confuse us?
entries.ro: Dacă o port eu, sigur nu ne confunzi?

entries.en: A replica. Made-to-order.
Quite sure, thanks.
Real jacket musta disintegrated into dust years ago.
entries.ro: Geaca originală s-a făcut praf demult.

entries.en: Had something for her, too.
Ya know... it seems you're starting to show your age.
entries.ro: Știi, începi să dai semne de vârstă.

entries.en: Just like me grandma – that woman never threw a ting away.
entries.ro: La fel ca bunica mea, care nu arunca nimic niciodată.

entries.en: Don't push it, Crispin.
Never know when it might come in handy.
entries.ro: Niciodată nu știi când îți prinde bine.

entries.en: Ah – minor details that happened to slip your mind earlier?
entries.ro: Ah – detalii minore care ți-au scăpat mai devreme?

entries.en: Mhm. 'Zackly.
Make it quick.
That is nice. But me don't share me father's aspirations.
entries.ro: E frumos. Dar eu nu-mi doresc ce-și dorea tata.

entries.en: So me expect to live longer than he did.
entries.ro: Așa că am de gând să trăiesc mai mult ca el.

entries.en: Me sure would. But not so close.
entries.ro: Sigur că da. Dar nu chiar așa de aproape.

entries.en: De bastard has a bad habit of comin' back from de dead.
entries.ro: Nenorocitul ăla are năravul de-a învia din morți.

entries.en: Mhm. True bastards somehow always find a way.
entries.ro: Mhm. Nenorociții adevărați găsesc mereu o portiță.

entries.en: Maybe, dunno. Don't wait up.
entries.ro: Poate, nu știu. Nu mă aștepta.

entries.en: What – you getting cold feet?
No. Just… don't wanna see Johnny haze you.
entries.en_m: No. Just… I don't wanna see Johnny haze you.
entries.ro: Nu. Doar… nu vreau să-l văd pe Johnny cum te umilește.

entries.en: Adam Smasher's his obsession, not yours.
entries.ro: Adam Smasher e obsesia lui, nu a ta.

entries.en: Heh, think so?
V, the fuck was that s'posed to be?
entries.ro: V, ce dracu' trebuia să fie aia?

entries.en: Just tryin' to play fair.
OK. Here's as far as we go.
Too many rats around. Better wait till a little darkness creeps in.
entries.ro: Prea mulți șobolani pe-aici. Mai bine așteptăm să se lase noaptea.

entries.en: Maybe Smasher or Grayson'll show.
Whadda we do till then?
And in the meantime, we do what?
Wait and watch.
Maybe Smasher or Grayson'll rear a head.
entries.ro: Poate se ivește Smasher sau Grayson.

entries.en: Least it's dark. Should be easier.
entries.ro: Măcar e întuneric. Ar trebui să fie mai ușor.

entries.en: Sure you're OK with this?
Weird you didn't run into Smasher sooner.
entries.ro: Ciudat că nu l-ai întâlnit pe Smasher mai devreme.

entries.en: Little weird you didn't run into Smasher before now.
entries.en_m: It's a little weird you didn't run into Smasher before now.
entries.ro: E un pic ciudat că nu l-ai întâlnit pe Smasher până acum.

entries.en: Came up in conversation. Time to time.
entries.ro: Mai vorbim despre el, din când în când.

entries.en: But, uh, never tried to track him down?
entries.en_m: Yeah, but, y-you never tried to track him down?
entries.ro: Dar, ăă, n-ai încercat niciodată să-l găsești?
entries.ro_m: Da, dar, n-n-ai încercat niciodată să-l găsești?

entries.en: Listen, V. Fact that Johnny's back changes things, OK?
entries.ro: Ascultă, V. Cu Johnny întors, lucrurile s-au schimbat, OK?

entries.en: OK, sure. Believe me, I'd know.
entries.en_m: OK, sure. Believe me, I know.

entries.en: We'll talk later.
Maybe. Don't hold your breath, though. Wouldn't be caught dead here in daylight.
entries.ro: Poate. Nu-ți face iluzii. N-aș fi prinsă moartă pe-aici, ziua.
entries.ro_m: Poate. Nu-ți face iluzii. N-aș fi prins mort pe-aici, ziua.

entries.en: OK. Good as it's gonna get.
entries.ro: OK. E cât se poate de bine.

entries.en: Been here before.
Grayson's been sitting on the docks since his last Maelstrom op.
entries.ro: Grayson stă pe docuri de când a terminat treaba aia cu Maelstrom.

entries.en: He works for them? Not for Smasher?
entries.en_m: So he works for them, not for Smasher.
entries.ro: Lucrează pentru ei? Nu pentru Smasher?
entries.ro_m: Deci lucrează pentru ei, nu pentru Smasher.

entries.en: Smasher always had a few irons in the fire.
entries.ro: Smasher avea mereu câteva afaceri pe mână.

entries.en: Assuming they're in it together – master and apprentice.
entries.ro: Dacă sunt amândoi băgați în asta – maestru și ucenic.

entries.en: What'd Johnny say about me?
Know you two talk all the time.
Johnny tends to talk about himself, mostly.
entries.ro: Johnny vorbește mai mult despre el, de obicei.

entries.en: Said you're the best.
entries.ro: A zis că ești cea mai bună. Ai fost mereu…
entries.ro_m: A zis că ești cel mai bun. Ai fost mereu…

entries.en: Any idea what Grayson's intentions are?
entries.ro: Ai vreo idee ce vrea Grayson?

entries.en: Johnny talks about himself, mostly.
entries.en_m: Oh, Johnny talks about himself, mostly.
entries.ro: A, Johnny vorbește mai mult despre el, de obicei.

entries.en: Hm, right.
Said you're the best. Always were…
entries.ro: A zis că ești cea mai bună. Ai fost mereu…
entries.ro_m: A zis că ești cel mai bun. Ai fost mereu…

entries.en: Hm, little too open-handed, but all right.
entries.ro: Hm, puțin prea darnică, dar bine.
entries.ro_m: Hm, puțin prea darnic, dar bine.

entries.en: The best. Too bad that comes at a price.
entries.ro: Cea mai bună. Doar că se plătește scump.
entries.ro_m: Cel mai bun. Doar că se plătește scump.

entries.en: [Take jacket]
Any idea what Grayson's got planned? Weyland tell you anything?
entries.ro: Ai vreo idee ce plănuiește Grayson? Ți-a spus Weyland ceva?

entries.en: She a shy one? Don't look it.
entries.en_m: He a shy one? Don't look it.

entries.en: You ghostin' already, sistah?
[Get in]
